messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync: SecureMesh reached out about listing their HSM-backed secrets connector. Scope: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (PATCH + bulk), and HSM key-wrap. Who can pick owners and blockers? :wave:

ajay (security): I9ll take HSM/KMS validation. Need: attestation PDF, wrap/unwrap API spec, supported algorithms (RSA-OAEP/AES-GCM/AES-KW), TLS cert chain, and a read-only test wrap key. Also want key rotation cadence and incident contact.

leo (eng): I can own SAML runtime and integration tests. Please send IdP metadata, sample SAML assertions, ACS URLs, and expected NameID format. I9ll add a toggleable CI smoke test.

tara (product): I9ll own SCIM and marketplace listing. Need sample user payload, group mapping doc, whether SCIM PATCH is supported, screenshots, and short/long blurb for the marketplace.

securemesh-ps: We can provide IdP metadata and SCIM sandbox this week. HSM vendor: SecureHSM (hosted). We9ll include attestation and a sandbox wrap endpoint. Preferred announcement window: Jun 10 09:00 PT.

maria (partnerships): Sounds good. Ajay/Leo/Tara, can you confirm what you need from SecureMesh by EOD Tue? I9ll draft the marketplace blurb + screenshot request.

ajay (security): Confirming: 1) attestation PDF, 2) wrap/unwrap endpoints, 3) test wrap key (read-only), 4) supported algs, 5) rotation policy. I9ll schedule a short threat-model after we get attestation.

leo (eng): Confirming: IdP metadata, TLS cert thumbprint, 2 SAML test accounts, SP metadata from our side. Quick fetch example for them: `curl -sS https://idp.securemesh.com/metadata -o idp.xml`

tara (product): Confirming: SCIM sample, group mapping, PATCH vs full behavior, error codes (429), and a screenshot of admin UI. I9ll draft blurb once I have the screenshot.

securemesh-ps: We9ll send sandbox creds, IdP metadata, attestation, sample SCIM payloads, and a logo package by EOD Tue. We9ll also run the wrap test you requested.

ajay (security): Example wrap test for SecureMesh to run and paste output (base64):
`curl -X POST https://sandbox.securemesh.com/kms/wrap -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap","plaintext":"VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3Q="}'`

leo (eng): SCIM sample for our tests:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{
  "userName": "j.wong",
  "displayName": "J Wong",
  "emails": [{"value":"j.wong@securemesh.com"}]
}

ci-bot: draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/999 (placeholder listing + install guide stub).

maria (partnerships): Action items recap:
- SecureMesh -> send IdP metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, HSM attestation, logo + screenshots by EOD Tue.
- ajay -> schedule 30m threat-model after attestation (target Wed).
- leo -> add SAML + SCIM smoke tests to partner CI (toggleable).
- tara -> draft marketplace short + long blurb and screenshot requests.

securemesh-ps: Confirmed 90 Thanks everyone.
maria (partnerships): Thanks 0 I'll send calendar invites and a short agenda. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
